## What's needed
The platform capability, not the tenant feature. Tenant-neutral.

## Why
What the pack is trying to do and why config, seeds or a pack plugin cannot do it today (what you grepped in `.platform/`).

## Blocking
The pack PR, issue or Linear issue waiting on this. `none` if nothing is blocked yet.

## Proposed slot or contract
The extension point, config key, API fields or behaviour you propose, and what the pack will do once it exists. Paste `git -C .platform diff` in a `<details>` block if you prototyped.

Requested by: <Cursor agent URL, if you are an agent>
